Air Duct Cleaning Sydney

What Is Ducted Air Conditioning Cleaning and Why Does It Matter?

Your ducted AC system pushes air through a network of ducts and vents throughout your home. Over time those ducts collect dust, mould, bacteria and allergens. Every time you run your system, you are breathing that in.

💨

Air Duct Cleaning

We remove built-up dust, mould and contaminants from every duct in your system. The result is cleaner air circulating through your home every single day.

🔧

Duct and Vent Cleaning

Beyond the ducts, we clean every supply and return vent, grille and diffuser. No part of your ducted air conditioning system is overlooked.

🏋

Ductwork Maintenance

Regular air duct maintenance prevents costly repairs, improves energy efficiency and extends the life of your entire ducted air conditioning system.

Signs You Need Air Duct Cleaning

What Happens When Your Air Ducts Are Not Cleaned?

Dirty air ducts are one of the most overlooked health hazards in Sydney homes. If your ducted system has not been professionally cleaned in the last 12 months, this is what is happening right now.

  • !
    Contaminated air circulates through every room. Dust, mould spores and bacteria travel through your ducts and into the air your family breathes every day.
  • $
    Your power bills keep climbing. Blocked and dirty ducts force your system to work harder, consuming up to 40% more electricity than a clean system.
  • ~
    Musty smells that never go away. That persistent musty smell when you run your ducted AC is mould inside your ductwork. It will not go away on its own.
  • *
    Uneven cooling across rooms. Blocked ducts restrict airflow, meaning some rooms get no cold air while others are fine. A common sign the system needs cleaning.
  • X
    Expensive breakdowns are more likely. Neglected duct and vent cleaning leads to system overload, component failure and costly callout fees.

Frequently Asked Questions

Air Duct Cleaning Sydney FAQ

Everything you need to know about ducted air conditioning cleaning, duct and vent cleaning and what to expect from our service.

We recommend professional air duct cleaning every 12 months for most Sydney homes. If you have pets, young children, allergy sufferers or the system runs heavily, every 6 months is ideal. Sydney's humid climate accelerates mould growth inside ductwork.

The cost of air duct cleaning in Sydney depends on the size of your system, number of vents and the level of contamination found. We provide a free, upfront quote with no hidden fees. Contact us and we will get back to you fast with a clear price.

Key signs include a musty smell when the system runs, visible dust around vents, uneven airflow between rooms, rising power bills and increased allergy symptoms at home. If your ducted system has not been cleaned in over 12 months, it almost certainly needs attention.

Yes. Aircon mould removal is a core part of our air duct cleaning service. We use eco-friendly products to safely eliminate mould colonies from inside your ductwork, treat affected areas to prevent regrowth and ensure your system circulates clean air.

Air duct cleaning focuses on cleaning the ducts and vents. Ducted AC cleaning is a broader service that includes the air handler, coils, fan, filters and all ductwork. We offer both and will recommend the right service after inspecting your system.

Yes. We offer same-day bookings across all Sydney suburbs subject to availability. Call us on 0483 928 714 and we will do our best to get a technician to you today. You can also submit a quote request online and we will respond within hours.
